summary: #smallpoems roamed vast spaces of the Mighty Garden weaving in dreams as light rained down bottled in moments of good now 4 legged beasts descend upon our paths always hungry, salivating for more freedom choked only rich in the pit can move
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
roamed
vast spaces of the
Mighty Garden
weaving in dreams
as light rained down
bottled in moments of good

now 4 legged beasts descend
upon our paths
always hungry, salivating
for more
freedom choked
only rich
in the pit
can move
